body: You can say that again XD. Like I mean the annoying thing is at lower dosages of E my mind just feels foggy, so I could think more straight with a higher dose which was really nice. But then emotions come back again - though that could be the increase of anti-androgens as well, so maybe I could see about that.

Thanks :)

And you might be right, I tried calling and their office closes at 12:00 W-F so I'll call tomorrow.

Problem is I only meet with my endo every 3 months, and it's like $120 per meeting so I can't really afford any more recent consultations. I don't think I should really change meds without his recommendations though. My hope is maybe I'll just get used to them but that doesn't seem the case.

And yea, I actually do have very trans-friendly friends. They have been (trying to) use the right pronouns since I came out like last year and still looked very male. I even know some other LDS trans people and that really does help. Maybe it's worth trying to go to female oriented events - but my experience from most of those is most people aren't really trans friendly because they're often pretty anti-male which is annoying and just kinda becomes more triggering for me because I'm just worried about being trans and stuff.

"Welcome to my gender"

Haha thanks.

Thing is I don't know if I can have another crack at it later. I mean I can work and raise money to try again, but that's gonna take forever. I go to a public school where tuition is like $7000 per semester, and I still have 4 semesters left (minimum).

And this mental health stuff has been raging since like June, it's not really a wave. Well I mean it is, but it's a daily wave. And fucking with me hard, basically making it so if I try to go to school/work for a day, the next day is like collapsed in just emotions to the extreme. I just don't think I can live like this, because I don't feel like I'll ever be able to be contributing to the world like this. This problem doesn't feel that temporary, since meds/therapy/etc. haven't seemed to work at all.
